use std::ptr;


pub struct fastdata;
impl fastdata {

    #[inline(always)]
    fn multiply_high(a: u64, b: u64) -> u64 { ((a as u128 * b as u128) >> 64) as u64 }
    #[inline(always)]
    fn coordinate(key: f64) -> u64 {
        let bits = if key == 0.0 { 0 } else { key.to_bits() };
        (if bits & 0x8000000000000000_u64 != 0 {
            !bits
        } else {
            bits ^ 0x8000000000000000_u64
        }) as u64
    }


    const KEYS: [f64; 2] = [
        f64::MIN, f64::MAX
    ];

    #[must_use]
    pub fn key_slice() -> &'static [f64] { &Self::KEYS }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn keys() -> impl Iterator<Item = f64> {
        Self::KEYS.iter().copied()
    }

    #[must_use]
    pub fn contains(key: f64) -> bool {
        if ((key != key))
        {
         return false;
        }


        let mut lo: i32 = 0;
        let mut hi: i32 = 1;
        if !(key >= Self::KEYS[0] && key <= Self::KEYS[hi as usize]) {
            return false;
        }
        let first_offset = Self::multiply_high(Self::coordinate(key).wrapping_sub(4503599627370496) << 0, 2);
        let first = if first_offset > hi as u64 { hi } else { first_offset as i32 };
        let first_key = Self::KEYS[first as usize];
        if first_key == key {
            return true;
        }
        if first_key < key { lo = first + 1; }
        else { hi = first - 1; }
        while lo <= hi && key >= Self::KEYS[lo as usize] && key <= Self::KEYS[hi as usize] {
            let lo_key: f64 = Self::KEYS[lo as usize];
            let hi_key: f64 = Self::KEYS[hi as usize];

            if lo_key == hi_key {
                if lo_key == key {
                    return true;
                }

                break;
            }

            let range = Self::coordinate(hi_key).wrapping_sub(Self::coordinate(lo_key));
            let delta = Self::coordinate(key).wrapping_sub(Self::coordinate(lo_key));
            let normalized_range = range >> 32;
            let mid: i32;
            if normalized_range < (hi - lo) as u64 {
                mid = lo + ((hi - lo) >> 1);
            } else {
                let reciprocal = (((hi - lo) as u64) << 32) / normalized_range + 1;
                let offset = Self::multiply_high(delta << 0, reciprocal);
                mid = if offset > (hi - lo) as u64 { hi } else { lo + offset as i32 };
            }

            let mid_key: f64 = Self::KEYS[mid as usize];
            if mid_key == key {
                return true;
            }
            if mid_key < key {
                lo = mid + 1;
            } else {
                hi = mid - 1;
            }
        }

        false
    }
